explanations: The contract says get() returns null only when the key doesn't exist and rejects on any other failure. ObjectStorageBlobStore.get catches every error and returns null, so a timeout or AccessDenied looks like "no avatar yet". getOrCreateAvatar trusts the contract, generates an initials avatar and overwrites the uploaded photo. Translating only NoSuchKey to null and rethrowing everything else makes the implementation interchangeable with MemoryBlobStore, which is what the shared contract tests check.
